comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Mainly commercial property and casualty insurer; its annuity unit overlaps but is only one separate business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Specialty commercial casualty and property insurer for hard-to-place business risks; no retail annuity or life business.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Online health insurance marketplace earning carrier commissions from enrollments, not an insurer selling its own annuities and life policies.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Franchised insurance brokerage placing auto, home and commercial coverage for other carriers; does not underwrite or hold policyholder funds.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Regional property and casualty insurer for small businesses and homeowners; no annuity or life insurance products.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Life insurance is only one piece alongside mortgage lending and cemetery and mortuary operations, a diversified mix unlike F&G.
